newsitem.title: USA: Christopher loves Irish coffee, no whiskey please.
newsitem.headline: Christopher loves Irish coffee, no whiskey please.

text.p: Secretary of State Warren Christopher loves Irish coffee -- but without the Irish whiskey and the caffeine, please.
The straight-laced Christopher stopped 32 times in Ireland during his four-year tenure, mostly to refuel his plane at Shannon Airport, which is famous for its Irish coffee.
White House spokesman Mike McCurry, who was Christopher's State Department spokesman for two years, told the story.

"It used to be the custom of many members of the travelling party to order Irish coffee, a drink that the airport is well-known for there," McCurry said. "Secretary Christopher ... used to order an Irish coffee and ask that they make it with decaf and 'hold the whiskey, please,'" he said.
